item.title: Teaching Python through an end-to-end data workshop
item.description:
AlgoETS/Workshop1

★ 3 · 0 forks · Repository created 2023-09-07

GitHub statistics recorded October 20, 2026.

The most useful beginner workshop gives each new concept somewhere to go. AlgoETS/Workshop1 moves from Python setup to an API response, a DataFrame, and a chart. The final notebook uses Apple price data and exponential moving averages to bring those steps together.

item.title: Economics of LEGO Sets with Data Science
item.description: I collect LEGO and write Python — so I merged Rebrickable exports with a BrickEconomy scraper to see how sets, colors, and themes evolved, and whether a simple model could explain prices on classics like 001-1. This page is the story with charts; full notebooks live in AlgoETS/LegosTracker. Version française.
